name: io.github.chrischall/insync-mcp
description: Use an InSync (Qualifacts) patient portal: reads, file transfer, messages and care requests

environmentVariables.name: INSYNC_PORTAL
environmentVariables.description: Your practice's portal, scheme and host only, e.g. https://<practice>intouch.insynchcs.com.

environmentVariables.name: INSYNC_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Portal username. Set with INSYNC_PASSWORD to sign in server-side. Leave both empty to relay through your signed-in browser tab.

environmentVariables.name: INSYNC_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Portal password. A rejected sign-in is never retried automatically, because the portal counts failures toward a lockout.

environmentVariables.name: INSYNC_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: server or fetchproxy. Default: server when both credentials are set, otherwise fetchproxy.

environmentVariables.name: INSYNC_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where downloaded files are written locally (a path-delimiter list; ~ expands). Default ~/Downloads and ~/Documents. A per-call dest must resolve inside one of these.

environmentVariables.name: INSYNC_INLINE_DOWNLOADS
environmentVariables.description: true returns downloaded bytes inline (base64) instead of writing to disk — for a hosted runner whose disk the user cannot reach. Default false (disk).

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
